import sys

def calc(a, b):
    global mna, mnb, x, y
    if a < 0:
        return
    if mna == -1:
        mna = a
        mnb = b
        return
    # Compare |mnb*x - mna*y| * b vs |b*x - a*y| * mnb
    left = abs(mnb * x - mna * y) * b
    right = abs(b * x - a * y) * mnb
    if left > right:
        mnb = b
        mna = a
    elif left == right:
        if b < mnb or (b == mnb and a < mna):
            mna = a
            mnb = b

def main():
    global mna, mnb, x, y
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    x = int(data[0])
    y = int(data[1])
    n = int(data[2])
    mna = -1
    mnb = -1
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        cur = i * x // y
        a = cur - 1
        calc(a, i)
        a = cur
        calc(a, i)
        a = cur + 1
        calc(a, i)
    print(f"{mna}/{mnb}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
</translated_code>
